en: The front shows an old sepia photograph of a large wooden house typical of 19th- and early 20th-century Nordic architecture, with decorative porch columns and a symmetrical facade. Three people, likely a family, are sitting on the front steps. The yard is open with flowering bushes in the foreground. The back is a typical blank divided postcard with lines for an address, a box for a stamp, and faint handwritten text along the dividing line.
